agent.description: Agent name — resolves to ~/.synaps-cli/agents/<name>.md. Mutually exclusive with system_prompt.

context_rollover.description: Optional. "off" runs this worker without context rollover; "inherit" (the default) follows this session's context management.

model.description: Omit to inherit the session foreground qualified identity. Explicit values must be one of subagent_models' listed exact choices.

name.description: Short display name for an inline (system_prompt) subagent, e.g. "gif-recorder". Shown in the subagent panel and in status/collect output. Letters, digits, - and _ only, max 32. Ignored when agent is set; defaults to "inline".

system_prompt.description: Inline system prompt for the subagent. Use when you don't have a named agent file.

task.description: The task/prompt to send to the subagent.

thinking.description: Worker effort override. Omit for subagent_thinking (default xhigh), independent of foreground thinking. Unsupported model levels are refused.

timeout.description: Wall-clock limit in seconds. Omit for the session default (config `subagent_timeout`); 0 = no limit.
